json.scope: Real production dependency helpers, official Node installation, pinned Playwright, headless Chromium and the newly built native client on Windows
checks: Actual Windows runtime is required
The release smoke runs under native PowerShell 7
The parent created the temporary smoke directory
Runner architecture matches the release target
The parent assigned the worker to its owned Windows job before installation
Both installers have one browser dependency block
Both self-contained installers use the identical production browser implementation
The production release installer parses
The bounded downloader function Wait-DownloadTask is unambiguous
The bounded downloader function Receive-BoundedStream is unambiguous
The bounded downloader function Invoke-BoundedDownload is unambiguous
Only function definitions are imported from the browser block
The client is the native executable for this target
The client version matches the validated release
The clean-install pass cannot reuse a preinstalled Node from PATH
Explicit runtime overrides are absent for the clean-install pass
The clean pass downloaded the official Node checksum list and archive
Dependency setup restored PATH before native client verification
The official managed Node 24 LTS installation runs with npm
Node PE architecture matches the release target
Node executes as the expected Windows architecture
The actual installed Playwright version is pinned to 1.65.1
The selected browser is the downloaded Playwright Chromium
The new client reports native browser readiness
The client resolves the exact selected Node and Chromium without a modified PATH
Chromium starts headlessly, renders a local page and closes successfully
The second real setup pass reuses Node without another download
The second setup pass preserves the selected runtime paths
Reusing dependencies preserves Node, Chromium and the pinned package bytes
Production persistence selects the verified runtime paths
